summary: Takeda Pharmaceutical filed a Form 6-K furnishing its earnings report (Kessan Tanshin) for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes consolidated financial results, dividend information, and forecasts for the upcoming year. Revenue decreased 1.7% to ¥4,505.7 billion, while net profit attributable to owners was negative ¥152.4 billion. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring is disclosed. This is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US earnings release on Form 8-K. No deal terms or special-situation mechanics are present.
